intro: Every tattoo is drawn custom, so there's no fixed price list. Your price depends on the design, your artist, and how long it takes. Here's how it works.

factors.title: Size
factors.description: Larger pieces take more time to draw and tattoo. Size is the biggest single factor in your price.

factors.title: Detail
factors.description: Fine line work, shading, and intricate patterns take longer than bold, simple designs of the same size.

factors.title: Placement
factors.description: Some areas, like ribs, hands, and feet, are harder to tattoo and can take longer to get right.

factors.title: Color
factors.description: Color work usually takes more passes than black and grey, which adds time.

factors.title: Sessions
factors.description: Large pieces like sleeves and back pieces are done over several sessions and priced per session.

policies.title: Deposits
policies.description: A non-refundable deposit is required to book. It goes toward the final cost of your tattoo.

policies.title: Cancellations
policies.description: Give at least 48 hours' notice to reschedule and keep your deposit. Late cancellations or no-shows forfeit the deposit.

policies.title: Touch-ups
policies.description: One free touch-up within 3 months, as long as you followed the after care instructions.

policies.title: Payment
policies.description: We accept cash and all major cards. Payment is due at the end of each session.

faqs.question: Can I get a quote over Instagram?
faqs.answer: We can give a rough estimate if you send your idea, size, and placement. Your final price is confirmed at your consultation.

faqs.question: Is there a shop minimum?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every tattoo has a shop minimum that covers setup, sterile supplies, and cleanup, no matter how small the design.

faqs.question: Do I need to tip?
faqs.answer: Tips are never required but always appreciated. Most clients tip between 15% and 20%.

faqs.question: Do you charge for drawing the design?
faqs.answer: No. Design time is included in the price of your tattoo.

faqs.question: Can I bring a friend?
faqs.answer: One guest is welcome during your session, as long as there's room in the studio.
